Alisa: quick note — onboarding Ventus LoRA (ventus/lora-v2) on int8. quick-eval flagged weird invoice tokenization: spaced digits and dropped $ signs.

Mohit: which evalpack and a couple example fails?

Alisa: evalpack=ventus-qc-2026-03. CI summary: QA 92.1% -> 88.4%, token anomalies=12 (digits split, currency dropped).

Dana: sounds like token-id shift after grafting. Any new special tokens?

Alisa: yes, adapter inserted ###AMOUNT which shifted indices; I didn\u2019t run remap after merge. Diff shows insertion near numeric token block.

Sam: re-run with --tok-remap and --no-kv-cache to rule out KV.

Alisa: running: ./scripts/run_quick_eval.sh --model ventus-lora-v2 --quant int8 --evalpack ventus-qc-2026-03 --tok-remap remap-v2.json --no-kv-cache --out /tmp/ventus-smoke.json
Partial logs: sample 127: "Invoice total is 1 0 0 0" parsed as spaced digits; sample 198: "$120" -> "120"

Mohit: confirms multi-digit tokens split; remap should fix contiguous digit tokens.

Alisa: remap run results: QA 92.1% -> 91.8% (-0.3), token anomalies 1 (was 12), latency +3% int8, no KV-cache effect.

Sam: action items: add remap generation in LoRA merge pipeline, post-merge token-id histogram check focusing on numeric/currency tokens, and a CI smoke test option to run tok-remap during merges. I'll open a PR.

Dana: add a docs blurb on "special-token insertions during adapter grafts" pointing to the PR.

Mohit: suggestion: upload token-id histograms to S3 so CS can forensics the customer model.
